The property is suitable for multiple uses, representing a unique opportunity for investors, businesses, and developers seeking a strategic area with strong tourist-commercial and nautical vocation. Among the main development possibilities: - Construction of a panoramic restaurant with terraces overlooking the water. - Bar, lounge, venues, and entertainment activities. - Marina with docks for boat mooring. - Storage facilities with services dedicated to boating. - Mixed-use tourist-commercial complex as outlined in the attached projects. The area enjoys a particularly strategic position and has a depth reaching up to approximately 8 meters, allowing access and mooring even for larger vessels, making it especially attractive for initiatives related to the nautical sector. This is a rare opportunity to develop a high-value-added project in an area of strong tourist and economic interest.
